crossRefs.note: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I…
But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your…
because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

translations.web: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,
translations.bsb: That is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.
translations.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
translations.asv: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:
